Related: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from last year, but topped Street forecasts (CoinDesk).

  • Market-structure signals still separate Bitcoin-led from alt-led tapes: Bitcoin-led tapes usually concentrate gains in majors, while alt-led breadth shows up as wider category participation across the top-50. Related: Crypto Market Structure Explained (The Block).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Listed-product demand usually hits Bitcoin first, then filters into broader market beta if primary-market creations stay firm. Related: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K (CoinTelegraph).
